review:
Mighty Kong is a 2016 4x5, 50-line slot about a giant gorilla. A wild landing on the middle reel expands to fill the whole reel, which helps complete wins across many lines.

The free spins round lets you choose your bonus, with options up to 40 free spins and multipliers up to 8x, so you decide between more spins or bigger multipliers. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a maximum win for this title. Note the RTP is 94%, well below most modern games, so it's more expensive to play over time. It's mainly of interest for its choose-your-bonus feature.
